capabilities.name: Bill of lading field check
capabilities.summary: When a draft bill of lading arrives before it is issued, the documentation specialist gets a field-by-field comparison with the booking, the shipper's instructions and the packing list, with every difference marked. Nothing is issued or corrected.

capabilities.name: Carrier freight invoice check
capabilities.summary: The freight auditor gets a carrier invoice checked line by line against the shipment export and the rate confirmation: duplicate lines, rate differences and extra charges with no delivery or waiting-time record, each tied to its shipment. Accounts payable decides what to pay or dispute.

capabilities.name: Freight shortage record packet
capabilities.summary: When a receiver reports missing or damaged freight, the claims coordinator gets one packet lining up dispatch quantities, warehouse scans, bill of lading, proof of delivery, photos and the customer report, with each unanswered question listed. It assigns no fault and sends nothing.

capabilities.name: Inbound receiving exception trace
capabilities.summary: When what arrived does not match the advance shipment notice, the receiving supervisor or inventory controller gets the notice, the packing list and the scans side by side by item and lot, with missing references and questions to investigate. Nothing is adjusted and nobody is contacted.

capabilities.name: Missed dock window recovery brief
capabilities.summary: The dispatch supervisor gets one brief when a truck misses its dock appointment and the reports disagree: each stated arrival time, the receiving cutoff, the appointment record and the questions that need a decision. It contacts no one and books nothing.

capabilities.name: Yard shift handover brief
capabilities.summary: The outgoing yard or warehouse lead hands the incoming lead one brief: where each trailer stands, how long it has been on site, which dock issues are open and who follows up on each. No trailer is moved and no appointment is changed.
